title: Be A Helper
verse: When the hands of Moses became heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on one side and one on the other, and so his hands were steady until the sun went down. So Joshua destroyed Amalek and his army with the sword.
observation: I know many people who have talked about this story. It is a powerful example of how God uses us to help one another. However, many people talk about this story from the point of view of Moses. They talk about how important it is to have people come alongside you through the seasons of life. This is true, but it is also important to be the person who is coming alongside others. We should all hope to be Aaron and Hur, not just Moses. The true heroes of the story (other than God) are the ones who were willing to serve. Aaron and Hur were God’s vessels to Moses. They were his miracle. What a beautiful thing it is to be a miracle with skin on it for others!
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the chance to be Your hands and feet.
